navigationInstruction.instructions: Head east on Baker Hill Rd toward Ruxton Rd
Turn right onto E Shore Rd
Turn left onto S Service Rd
Merge onto I-495 E via the ramp on the left to Riverhead
Take exit 42 toward Northern Pkwy E/Hauppauge

Merge onto NY-347/NY-454 E
Pass by Valley Bank (on the right in 1 mi)

Keep left to continue on NY-347 E, follow signs for Port Jefferson
Pass by Carvel (on the right)
Continue straight to stay on NY-347 E

Turn right
